groups.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math
groups.description: Math document OCR extraction engine policy.

groups.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.quality-gate
groups.description: Math document Markdown quality gate policy.

groups.name: studio.textract.pdf.ocr-fallback
groups.description: PDF OCR fallback policy used when PDF text layer extraction returns no text.

properties.name: studio.features.textract.enabled
properties.description: Whether Studio textract auto-configuration is enabled.

properties.name: studio.textract.max-extract-size
properties.description: Maximum file size accepted for text extraction. Plain numbers are bytes; K, KB, M, MB, G, GB, T, and TB suffixes are supported.

properties.name: studio.textract.tesseract.datapath
properties.description: Tesseract tessdata directory used by image OCR.

properties.name: studio.textract.tesseract.language
properties.description: Tesseract OCR language expression.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engine
properties.description: PDF extraction engine selection. Supported values are auto, pdfbox, and pymupdf4llm.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.fallback-enabled
properties.description: Whether PDFBox fallback is allowed when PyMuPDF4LLM is selected and fails.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.pdfbox.enabled
properties.description: Whether the PDFBox PDF extraction engine is enabled.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.pymupdf4llm.enabled
properties.description: Whether the optional PyMuPDF4LLM worker PDF extraction engine is enabled.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.pymupdf4llm.endpoint
properties.description: PyMuPDF4LLM worker POST /extract/pdf endpoint.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.pymupdf4llm.timeout
properties.description: HTTP timeout for PyMuPDF4LLM worker calls.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.pymupdf4llm.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum PDF size sent to the PyMuPDF4LLM worker. Plain numbers are bytes; K, KB, M, MB, G, GB, T, and TB suffixes are supported.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.enabled
properties.description: Whether a dedicated math document OCR engine is enabled before heuristic math markdown fallback.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.provider
properties.description: Dedicated math OCR provider. Supported values are none, pix2text, and mathpix.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.fallback-providers
properties.description: Ordered fallback math OCR providers after the primary provider. Supported values are none, pix2text, and mathpix.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.quality-gate.enabled
properties.description: Whether math OCR results are checked before accepting the provider output.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.quality-gate.min-score
properties.description: Minimum score expected from math OCR Markdown quality checks.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.hybrid.enabled
properties.description: Whether math-like PDFs should keep a full baseline OCR/PyMuPDF result and apply Pix2Text/Mathpix only as a bounded math supplement.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.hybrid.sample-pages
properties.description: Maximum number of pages sent to the math OCR provider in hybrid mode. The full document still uses the baseline extraction route.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.hybrid.max-correction-pages
properties.description: Maximum number of severity-ranked pages corrected by math OCR or vision in one extraction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.hybrid.fallback-pages
properties.description: Number of sampled pages corrected when no explicit low-quality math page is detected.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.hybrid.wave-size
properties.description: Maximum pages sent in one vision correction wave.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.hybrid.time-budget
properties.description: Per-provider time budget for bounded math correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.enabled
properties.description: Whether page-scoped Korean prose OCR correction is enabled.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.endpoint
properties.description: Structured PDF endpoint for the self-hosted Korean OCR provider.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.timeout
properties.description: HTTP timeout for each Korean OCR page request.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum PDF size accepted by the Korean OCR provider client.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.max-pages
properties.description: Maximum number of severity-ranked Korean text pages corrected in one extraction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of consecutive pages sent to the Korean OCR provider per request.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.fallback-enabled
properties.description: Whether a secondary structured OCR endpoint is used when the primary Korean OCR provider fails or returns an incomplete catastrophic correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.fallback-endpoint
properties.description: Secondary structured OCR endpoint, typically a local PyMuPDF4LLM worker forced into OCR mode.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.korean-ocr.fallback-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of consecutive pages sent to the fallback Korean OCR endpoint per request.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.vision-correction.enabled
properties.description: Whether vision LLM math correction is attempted as an additive supplement for math-like PDFs.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.vision-correction.provider
properties.description: Vision LLM provider for math correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.vision-correction.gemini.base-url
properties.description: Gemini API base URL used for vision math correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.vision-correction.gemini.api-key
properties.description: Gemini API key used for vision math correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.vision-correction.gemini.model
properties.description: Gemini model used for vision math correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.vision-correction.gemini.timeout
properties.description: Gemini request timeout for vision math correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.vision-correction.gemini.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum PDF size sent to Gemini vision math correction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.pix2text.endpoint
properties.description: Pix2Text self-host PDF-to-Markdown endpoint.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.pix2text.timeout
properties.description: HTTP timeout for Pix2Text self-host calls.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.pix2text.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum PDF size sent to Pix2Text. Plain numbers are bytes; K, KB, M, MB, G, GB, T, and TB suffixes are supported.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.pix2text.language
properties.description: Language hint passed to the Pix2Text self-host endpoint.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.pix2text.page-by-page
properties.description: Whether Pix2Text should extract and return per-page Markdown blocks with page provenance.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.pix2text.batch-size
properties.description: Number of PDF pages sent per Pix2Text request when the source has more pages than this value. Smaller batches avoid long single-request timeouts and make fallback behavior explicit.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.mathpix.api-base-url
properties.description: Mathpix API v3 base URL.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.mathpix.timeout
properties.description: HTTP timeout for Mathpix calls.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.mathpix.poll-interval
properties.description: Polling interval for Mathpix async PDF conversion.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.mathpix.max-poll-attempts
properties.description: Maximum polling attempts for Mathpix async PDF conversion.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.mathpix.app-id
properties.description: Mathpix app_id credential.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.engines.math.mathpix.app-key
properties.description: Mathpix app_key credential.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.auto.prefer-pymupdf4llm-when.min-pages
properties.description: When engine=auto and the worker is enabled, prefer PyMuPDF4LLM for PDFs with at least this many pages.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.auto.prefer-pymupdf4llm-when.table-detection-required
properties.description: Reserved preference flag for request-level table extraction hints.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.auto.prefer-pymupdf4llm-when.ocr-required
properties.description: Reserved preference flag for request-level OCR hints.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.auto.prefer-pymupdf4llm-when.preserve-layout
properties.description: Reserved preference flag for request-level layout preservation hints.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.ocr-fallback.enabled
properties.description: Whether PDFBox should render PDF pages and run Tesseract OCR when the PDF text layer is empty.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.ocr-fallback.max-pages
properties.description: Maximum number of PDF pages rendered for OCR fallback.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.ocr-fallback.dpi
properties.description: Render DPI used for PDF OCR fallback.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.large-pdf.enabled
properties.description: Whether large PDFs should be split into PyMuPDF4LLM page-range parts.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.large-pdf.page-threshold
properties.description: Minimum PDF page count that triggers page-range part extraction.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.large-pdf.batch-size
properties.description: Number of PDF pages sent to the worker per page-range part.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.large-pdf.continue-on-part-failure
properties.description: Whether extraction continues after an individual page-range part fails.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.large-pdf.max-part-failures
properties.description: Maximum failed page-range parts before extraction aborts. Zero means no explicit limit.

properties.name: studio.textract.pdf.large-pdf.include-images
properties.description: Whether worker responses include image references during large PDF extraction.

properties.description: Legacy text extraction feature wiring toggle.
